added.summary: The water at a point: of every og.Water, og.WaterSurface and og.WaterLine over it, the one whose surface stands highest, with the point's depth under it and the water's velocity, acceleration and surface normal there (og.WaterPoint); null over no water. It answers inside a system (reading og.Water and og.Transform) as between ticks, from the function the simulation floats bodies on.
